observation_summary: The compiler incorrectly removed an assignment to a variable that was subsequently used in the same expression, leading to incorrect JavaScript output.
reasoning_summary: The DeadAssignmentsElimination pass incorrectly identified an assignment as 'dead' and removed it, even though the variable was subsequently read in the right-hand side of the same expression. Specifically, the compiler failed to check if the variable being assigned was also being read in the RHS of the assignment expression before marking it as a kill. The fix introduces a check to verify if the variable is read in the RHS before declaring it a 'KILL', preventing the premature removal of necessary assignments.
